_comment: Mutation-testing config for the installer logic. Stryker has NO PowerShell
runner (it mutates JS/TS/C#/Scala only), so mutation-runner.ps1 implements an
equivalent engine that reads THIS file: it generates one mutant per swap
occurrence in logic-sim.ps1, runs the Pester suites against each mutant, and
fails if the kill score drops below thresholds.break. The schema mirrors
Stryker's (mutate / testRunner / thresholds) so intent is unambiguous.
The root-level stryker.config.json is the SEPARATE, unrelated config for the
JS app's @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner and is intentionally left untouched.
logic-sim.ps1 is a pure-decision mirror with no destructive statements (no
Remove-Item/DeleteFile/DelTree), so a RemoveStatement mutator would be inert.
The cleanup DECISION is mutated via the boolean/string mutators (Get-CleanupPlan);
